scenes.en: It steals sight with no pain and no warning.
scenes.say: This eye problem steals your sight silently. No pain, no warning.

scenes.en: It slowly damages the eye nerve. Side vision fades first.
scenes.say: It's called glaucoma. It slowly damages the nerve of the eye, and side vision fades first, so most people don't notice it.

scenes.en: If a parent or grandparent had it, your risk is higher.
scenes.say: If a parent or grandparent had glaucoma, your risk is higher. Age over forty and diabetes also raise the risk.

scenes.en: But finding it early helps protect the sight you have.
scenes.say: Vision lost to glaucoma does not come back. But finding it early helps protect the sight you have.

scenes.en: Book a full eye check with an eye specialist.
scenes.say: So after forty, or with a family history, get a full eye check by an eye specialist. Book one for your parents today.
